summary: adeleExtension at τ reads the component at the conjugate induced place, where embedGL puts the diagN component.

steps.claim: adeleExtension along weightEmbedding(ιₚ, τ) reads the component of embedGL(·) at the conjugate of the induced place of τ, which lies in D.nonInducedPlaces; there embedGL places the corresponding component of diagN (atPlace_atSplits).
steps.lean:
congr($(atPlace_atSplits star_notMem _
  ⟨_, by simp [nonInducedPlaces, inducedPlace, placeOfEmb_comp_star]⟩).map _).trans

steps.claim: That component is diag(1, …, 1, N or 1) by the definition of diagN.
